description: Quality dataset (Phase 18): 30 prompts covering portrait/landscape/text rendering/complex composition/multiple objects/fine detail/photorealistic/illustration/long/short/Chinese/English. Fixed per-prompt seeds; identical generation params across routes; ONLY the conditioning route varies.

prompts.text: Close-up portrait of an elderly fisherman with deep wrinkles, salt-and-pepper beard, and sea-blue eyes, wearing a yellow raincoat, soft overcast light, shallow depth of field, photorealistic, 85mm lens.
A golden retriever puppy sitting in a field of sunflowers at sunset, backlit rim light, photorealistic.
